versions.changelog:
ImageCraft 2.0.0 — Major update with comprehensive, category-based image generation

- Consolidates image generation into four categories: Characters, Scenes, Products, and Style Transformation, covering 17 unique styles.
- Introduces dedicated workflow and prompt templates for each style, with clear execution rules for concise communication and direct image delivery.
- Adds language detection for all outputs and enforces minimal, streamlined user guidance and interaction.
- Images are now delivered directly using a standardized format; explanations and summaries are removed throughout.
- Interactive options and style picking now always use `genui-form-wizard` (plain text tables are forbidden).
- Example generation mode ("try it") available with built-in sample cases for every style.
